Blocks.Text: The Candidate Pipeline endpoint represents information about a candidate that is specific to a single pipeline. A candidate's pipeline information should be synced to the Middleware Platform whenever a candidate is added to, removed from, or updated inside a pipeline in your CRM. When a customer activates CRM Connect for the first time, you must sync all of their historical data to LinkedIn to power the integration.
Note
The latest API version is 202604. Use this version in the LinkedIn-Version header for all API requests to access the most recent features and improvements.
Note
Please submit batch calls grouped with no more than 100 records in sequential order.
https://api.linkedin.com/v2/tcrmCandidatePipelines
https://api.linkedin.com/rest/candidatePipelines

Blocks.Section: Sync Candidate Pipelines via Batch Update
SectionPath: Sync Candidate Pipelines via Batch Update
Blocks.Text: Perform HTTP PUT on the /tcrmCandidatePipelines endpoint to sync candidate pipeline associations to LinkedIn. Batch requests require the x-restli-method: batch_update header. Multiple records can be sent in a single API request as indicated in the example below.

Blocks.Text: Perform HTTP DELETE on the /tcrmCandidatePipelines endpoint when a customer deletes candidate pipeline records.
Perform HTTP DELETE on the /candidatePipelines endpoint when a customer deletes candidate pipeline records.

curl -i -X DELETE "https://api.linkedin.com/v2/tcrmCandidatesPipelines?ids%5B0%5D.tcrmCandidateId=tcrmCandidateId100&ids%5B0%5D.integrationContext=urn:li:organization:1234567890&ids%5B0%5D.dataProvider=PARTNER&ids%5B0%5D.tcrmPipelineId=tcrmPipeline05&ids%5B1%5D.tcrmCandidateId=tcrmCandidateId100&ids%5B1%5D.integrationContext=urn:li:organization:1234567890&ids%5B1%5D.dataProvider=PARTNER&ids%5B1%5D.tcrmPipelineId=tcrmPipeline06" \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
-H 'X-RestLi-Protocol-Version:1.0.0' \
-H 'Accept:application/json'

curl -i -X DELETE 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/candidatePipelines?ids%5B0%5D.externalCandidateId=tcrmCandidateId100&ids%5B0%5D.integrationContext=urn:li:organization:1234567890&ids%5B0%5D.externalPipelineId=tcrmPipeline05&ids%5B1%5D.externalCandidateId=tcrmCandidateId100&ids%5B1%5D.integrationContext=urn:li:organization:1234567890&ids%5B1%5D.externalPipelineId=tcrmPipeline06' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'LinkedIn-Version: 202603' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}'

curl -i -X DELETE 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/candidatePipelines?ids%5B0%5D.externalCandidateId=tcrmCandidateId100&ids%5B0%5D.integrationContext=urn:li:organization:1234567890&ids%5B0%5D.externalPipelineId=tcrmPipeline05&ids%5B1%5D.externalCandidateId=tcrmCandidateId100&ids%5B1%5D.integrationContext=urn:li:organization:1234567890&ids%5B1%5D.externalPipelineId=tcrmPipeline06' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'LinkedIn-Version: 202604' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}'
A successful request will return a 200 OK response code, and you will find the status of each entity in the response body.
